identity.canonicalName: 中国K12反馈素养｜反馈知识计分候选｜教师自评｜2025英文公开题文
identity.instrumentFamily: Kang, Huang, Liu & Yin 2025 K-12 teacher feedback-giving literacy final 30-item scale

construct.constructDefinition: Knowledge: published final item identities only. Original teacher response anchors, numeric coding, aggregation, missing-data policy and complete IRT item parameters have not been verified. Self-perceived knowledge/skills/values/actionability must not be called observed teaching quality.

population.populationNotes: Adult K-12 teachers able to read the published English items. The research was conducted in a Chinese K-12 sample and included pre-/in-service teachers; complete original Chinese wording was not supplied in the verified public material. 18+ is the project audience scope, not a study-derived age threshold. The separate digital components are not validated as standalone instruments.

administration.timeFrame: Original teacher administration window and instructions not verified.
layoutConstraints: Metadata only; no executable score or individual report.
English final item IDs: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, K7.
The paper’s 1–5 appropriateness anchors belong to the expert panel rating item suitability, not the teacher questionnaire. Do not reuse them as teacher response labels.
Supplementary DOCX Appendix A contains only information-function curves, not Chinese items or a scoring key.
No arithmetic total, latent ability estimate, normative level or cross-role difference is supplied. Time estimate is for planning only.

intendedUses.notes: Catalog identity/score-protocol follow-up; not ready for administration as a scored scale.

localization.translationSource: Kang, C., Huang, J., Liu, Y., & Yin, H. (2025). Development and validation of a generic self-assessment scale for K-12 teachers as feedback givers: Insights from item response theory and factor analysis. Humanities and Social Sciences Communications, 12, 616. https://doi.org/10.1057/s41599-025-04927-4. English public Tables 2–3; no original Chinese item form was obtained.
localization.notes: Scoring candidate only. Native long-text reflection adaptations and project Chinese working translations have separate identities; neither inherits original validation.

source.title: K-12 teacher feedback-giving literacy: published final 30 English items, Tables 2–3
source.citation: Kang, C., Huang, J., Liu, Y., & Yin, H. (2025). Development and validation of a generic self-assessment scale for K-12 teachers as feedback givers: Insights from item response theory and factor analysis. Humanities and Social Sciences Communications, 12, 616. https://doi.org/10.1057/s41599-025-04927-4.

limitations: Original teacher response anchors/coding and scoring/missing rules are not verified. Do not confuse expert appropriateness ratings with teacher responses.
Self-reported perception is not objective knowledge, observed practice or feedback actually received by students.
No executable score, teacher quality level or individualized numerical report is produced.
reportPlan.disclaimer: Metadata only; original scoring versions remain uncreated. Unscored reflection forms are separate project adaptations.
